The university president reinvited him and Adams spoke successfully.

name: Milo Yiannopoulos at The University of New Mexico (2017)

After the university backed down from its demands that the student-organizers, the College Republicans, pay an exorbitant security fee. Protests occurred outside the event and multiple people were arrested, but Yiannopoulos spoke successfully.

name: Lawrence Lockman at University of Southern Maine (2017)
explanation_400: A student activist group, Students for USM Future, called for the university to disinvite Lockman over comments Lockman made about abortion, homosexuality, rape, and immigration. Lockman spoke successfully.

name: Ben Shapiro at The University of Utah (2017)
explanation_400: Students objected to Shapiro's invitation, saying Shapiro exhibits "imperialism, racism, sexism, and homophobia." They protested outside the university president's office and wrote an op-ed in the local paper calling for Shapiro not to speak. The university refused to cancel the event and Shapiro spoke successfully.

name: Dennis Prager at University of Wyoming (2017)
explanation_400: Students vowed to attempt to cancel the event featuring Prager, accusing Prager of engaging in "hate speech." Prager spoke successfully.

Deek finished his remarks.

name: Ann Coulter at Fordham University (2012)

name: Sandra Soto at The University of Arizona (2010)

name: Ted Vogt at The University of Arizona (2010)

Vogt was then appointed to the Arizona State House of Representatives where he voted in favor of two controversial immigration bills that some law students considered racist. Law students started a petition to demand that Vogt step down as a commencement speaker. Vogt spoke successfully.

name: Geert Wilders at Temple University (2009)

name: Tom Tancredo at The University of North Carolina Chapel Hill (2009)

name: Virgil Goode at The University of North Carolina Chapel Hill (2009)

name: Phyllis Schlafly at Washington University in St. Louis (2008)

name: Jim Gilchrist at Columbia University (2007)

name: Jim Gilchrist at Columbia University (2006)

name: Peter DeFazio at Portland State University (2006)

Rodriguez withdrew from speaking at commencement despite administrative support.

name: Ward Churchill at University of Oregon (2005)
explanation_400: The university revoked Churchill's invitation to be a keynote speaker at a conference on race and immigration, fearing that Churchill's comments regarding 9/11 would shift the focus away from the intended subject of the conference.

name: Pat Buchanan at Western Michigan University (2005)
explanation_400: Students protested Buchanan's conservative views on immigration. One student protester doused Buchanan in salad dressing during his speech, causing Buchanan to end the event early.
